# Tour My India

> > Tour My India is a comprehensive travel platform offering guided tours, adventure packages, and travel guides across India's diverse destinations including the Himalayas, hill stations, wildlife sanctuaries, and pilgrimage sites.

Tour My India specializes in curated travel experiences spanning adventure tourism (trekking, jeep safaris, mountain biking), romantic getaways, spiritual journeys, and wildlife expeditions. The platform provides detailed destination guides for Indian states and cities, with particular focus on Himalayan regions like Ladakh, Jammu and Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, and Uttarakhand.

## Key Topics

- Himalayan destinations (Ladakh, Leh, Manali)
- Kashmir tourism (Srinagar, Gulmarg, Pahalgam, Dal Lake)
- Adventure activities (jeep safari, trekking, mountain biking)
- Honeymoon packages and romantic destinations
- Hill stations across India
- Pilgrimage and spiritual tourism
- Wildlife sanctuaries and bird watching
- Uttarakhand destinations (Rishikesh)
- Himachal Pradesh travel
- Maharashtra hill stations
- Buddhist heritage sites
- Peak expeditions and high-altitude treks
- Weekend getaways
- Luxury hotel bookings

## Popular Destinations & State Guides

- [Jammu and Kashmir Tourism & Travel Guide](https://www.tourmyindia.com/states/jammu-kashmir): Complete travel guide for Jammu Kashmir with Vaishno Devi & Amarnath info
- [Rishikesh Tourism - Best Travel Guide to Visit Rishikesh](https://www.tourmyindia.com/states/uttarakhand/rishikesh.html): Rishikesh guide: yoga capital, river rafting & Ganges pilgrimage sites
- [Mahabaleshwar Tourism & Travel Guide](https://www.tourmyindia.com/states/maharashtra/mahabaleshwar.html): Mahabaleshwar hill station guide in Western Ghats, Maharashtra
- [Bhopal Travel & Tour Tourism Guide, Madhya Pradesh](https://www.tourmyindia.com/states/madhyapradesh/bhopal.html): Bhopal tourism guide covering lakes, monuments & Islamic heritage sites
- [Nagpur Tourism & Travel Guide](https://www.tourmyindia.com/states/maharashtra/nagpur.html): Nagpur travel guide: Orange City, tiger capital & Ramtek attractions

## Adventure Tours & Activities

- [Jeep Safari Tours India - Best Places for Jeep Safari Expeditions](https://www.tourmyindia.com/adventure_tours/jeep_safari.html): Jeep safari expeditions in Ladakh, Spiti & wildlife parks across India
- [Manali to Leh Jeep Safari Tour](https://www.tourmyindia.com/packages-tour-india/adventure-tour-packages/manali-leh-jeep-safari.html): Overland jeep safari from Manali to Leh via mountain passes & monasteries
- [Mountain Biking in Himachal](https://www.tourmyindia.com/packages-tour-india/adventure-tour-packages/mountain-biking-himachal.html): 16-day mountain biking tour through Shimla, Sangla & Kalpa valleys
- [Mountain Biking in Ladakh](https://www.tourmyindia.com/packages-tour-india/adventure-tour-packages/mountain-biking-ladakh.html): 12-day high-altitude mountain biking adventure through Leh & Ladakh

- [Markha Valley Trek with Stok Kangri](https://www.tourmyindia.com/treks/markha-valley-and-stok-kangri-trek.html): Strenuous high-altitude Markha Valley & Stok Kangri trek in Ladakh
- [Manimahesh Kailash Trek - Spiritual Trek in Himachal Pradesh](https://www.tourmyindia.com/treks/manimahesh-kailash-trek.html): Spiritual pilgrimage trek to Manimahesh Lake in Himachal Pradesh
